## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A reverted or human-edited agent commit produces a correction record linked...

The system SHALL ensure that a reverted or human-edited agent commit produces a correction record linked to its trace and classified intent vs execution.

#### Scenario: A reverted or human-edited agent commit produces a correction record linked...

WHEN `intervention-capture` is implemented
THEN A reverted or human-edited agent commit produces a correction record linked to its trace and classified intent vs execution.

### Requirement: Correction records are written into the closed-loop-learning store, and no...

The system SHALL ensure that correction records are written into the closed-loop-learning store, and no new learning store is created.

#### Scenario: Correction records are written into the closed-loop-learning store, and no...

WHEN `intervention-capture` is implemented
THEN Correction records are written into the closed-loop-learning store, and no new learning store is created.

### Requirement: Only artifacts in the shared repository and coordinator are captured;...

The system SHALL ensure that only artifacts in the shared repository and coordinator are captured; private session transcripts are excluded unless the principal opts in.

#### Scenario: Only artifacts in the shared repository and coordinator are captured;...

WHEN `intervention-capture` is implemented
THEN Only artifacts in the shared repository and coordinator are captured; private session transcripts are excluded unless the principal opts in.
